desc:
Ultimate Tool Kit for Glock® handguns - includes four innovative multi-tools in a plastic hard carry case for Glock® armorers.
VTUPRS: Universal pistol rear sight tool designed for: removal, installation, and the adjusting windage of dovetail rear sights. US PATENTS: 9784535 & D829294. Aluminum and steel construction.
VTGLPRO: Glock® Pro Tool has five specific tools for Glock® pistols: magnetic 3/16” hex nut driver for the front sight, channel liner removal and channel liner install tool bits, hardened steel 3/32” (2.5mm) disassembly tool, striker assembly holder, and flat blade and Phillips screwdriver tool bit. Steel and polymer construction. US PATENT PENDING.
VTGLMAG: MagPopper tool will help you disassemble your Glock® magazines in seconds. US PATENT: D839377. Aluminum construction.
VTGLKPBL: Glock® Pocket Tool with hardened 3/32" (2.5mm) steel punch disassemble tool and a 3/16" hex nut driver (with magnetic tip) for removing/ installing Glock® front sights. Aluminum and steel
